## 范围声明 / Scope declaration

- [ ] 本 PR 只有一个主工作包 / This PR has one primary work package.
- [ ] 未引入后续工作包能力 / No later-work-package capability is included.
- [ ] 未修改 AEH normative truth / AEH normative truth is not modified.
- [ ] 未把推断标记为 confirmed / No inference is labeled as confirmed.
- [ ] 默认离线且没有新增外部数据流 / Offline default and external data-flow boundary are unchanged.

## 证据 / Evidence

列出原始证据、测试命令、结果和不可变引用。Gate 未通过时不得声明完成。
